name: Turkey Bolognese
method: Finely chop the onion, carrot, celery and mushrooms. Brown the turkey in the oil in a large pan, breaking it up, then set aside.
In the same pan, soften the vegetables and garlic for about 8 minutes, then stir in the tomato puree for a minute.
Return the turkey with the tomatoes, passata, oregano and crumbled stock cube. Simmer gently for 30 minutes until thick, adding a splash of water if it dries out.
Cook the spaghetti to the packet instructions and serve topped with the sauce.
